title: BeaverTails
hookLine: Canadian-inspired beavertails with 12 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: BeaverTails
steps.instructionTemplate: In the bowl of a stand mixer, add warm water, a big pinch of sugar and yeast. Allow to sit until frothy. Into the same bowl, add 1/2 cup sugar, warm milk, melted butter, eggs and salt, and whisk until combined. Incorporate {m52928_1}, {m52928_2}, {m52928_3}, and {m52928_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure water first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: BeaverTails
steps.instructionTemplate: Place a dough hook on the mixer, add the flour with the machine on, until a smooth but slightly sticky dough forms. Place dough in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and allow to proof for 1 1/2 hours. Incorporate {m52928_5}, {m52928_6}, {m52928_7}, {m52928_8}, {m52928_9}, {m52928_10}, {m52928_11}, and {m52928_12} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: BeaverTails
steps.instructionTemplate: Cut dough into 12 pieces, and roll out into long oval-like shapes about 1/4 inch thick that resemble a beaver’s tail. In a large, deep pot, heat oil to 350 degrees. Gently place beavertail dough into hot oil and cook for 30 to 45 seconds on each side until golden brown.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: BeaverTails
steps.instructionTemplate: Drain on paper towels, and garnish as desired. Toss in cinnamon sugar, in white sugar with a squeeze of lemon, or with a generous slathering of Nutella and a handful of toasted almonds. Enjoy!
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
